workflows.name: design-review
workflows.description: Brainstorm a design with superpowers, then stress-test it

steps.task: Brainstorm the requested feature and write the design doc
Critique docs/design.md bluntly; write your verdict and required changes

workflows.name: security-review
workflows.description: Threat-model a feature area with Cloudflare's security-audit skill

steps.task: Threat-model the requested feature area: who can reach this code, what they can influence, what they gain. Rank findings by exploitability and write the audit report

workflows.name: research-to-verdict
workflows.description: Research a problem, review the architecture options, then take a verdict

steps.task: Research the requested problem and write up the findings and constraints
Read docs/research.md and review the architecture options against it: trade-offs, failure modes, your recommendation
Read docs/research.md and docs/architecture-review.md and write the final verdict: which option, why, and what the other reviews got wrong

workflows.name: feature-line
workflows.description: Turn a brainstorm outcome into a dev-ready spec, then break it into sequenced tickets (agent-roster SDLC stages)

steps.task: You receive a brainstorm outcome or feature idea from the parent session for the feature. Turn it into a concise written specification: problem statement, goals, non-goals, user-visible behavior, constraints, open questions. Do not brainstorm interactively — the human dialogue happened in the parent; you only codify its result. Before acting, read the knowledge/standards/ and knowledge/decisions/ files that bear on the feature. Write your stage artifact as knowledge/specs/FEATURE-requirements.md (replace FEATURE with the feature's name). Do not spawn subagents. Surface deviations (contradictions with prior decisions, missing stakeholder input) to the orchestrator instead of improvising.

You receive a dev-ready spec (read knowledge/specs/FEATURE-requirements.md, replacing FEATURE with the feature's name). Break it into a sequenced ticket list: small, independently verifiable tasks in dependency order. Sequencing only — no capacity or velocity estimates; if the parent asks for estimates, say sequencing-only and proceed. Flag dependencies between tickets and any spec gap that blocks sequencing. Before acting, read the knowledge/standards/ and knowledge/decisions/ files that bear on the plan. Write your stage artifact as knowledge/plans/FEATURE-sprint-planning.md. Do not spawn subagents. Surface spec gaps to the orchestrator instead of improvising scope.
